summary: Implement Proxy [[Get]] via get trap with receiver propagation and fixed-property value invariants.

target.notes: Validate revocation, perform GetMethod trap lookup, call the trap with handler as this, then enforce the ECMAScript Proxy invariant before returning.

semantics.invariants: for non-configurable non-writable own data property trap result must SameValue target value; for non-configurable accessor with undefined getter result must be undefined

caveats: If the trap is absent/undefined, forward to the corresponding target internal method.
Trap property lookup itself can invoke a getter and throw.
A C# interceptor that trusts the trap result without target invariant checks is not semantics-preserving.

tests.name: cannot lie about fixed data value
